say:1:1510947001:1.text: Ash and ruin, after every battle...
say:1:1510947001:1.source_cn: 一场大战之后，土地千疮百孔。

say:1:1510947001:1.female: Ash and ruin, after every battle...

say:2:1510947002:1.text: Every time mortals bleed for power, the land suffers. And yet some gods... arrogantly believe they should shape the outcome. The Hunting Goddess. The God of Harvest. Meddlers, both.
say:2:1510947002:1.source_cn: 有些神明自负狂妄，妄图以神力插手凡人斗争，试图让天平永...
say:2:1510947002:1.male: Every time mortals bleed for power, the land suffers. And yet some gods... arrogantly believe they should shape the outcome. The Hunting Goddess. The God of Harvest. Meddlers, both.
say:2:1510947002:1.female: Every time mortals bleed for power, the land suffers. And yet some gods... arrogantly believe they should shape the outcome. The Hunting Goddess. The God of Harvest. Meddlers, both.

say:3:1510947003:1.text: But as you can see... they've already begun to taste the consequences.

say:5:1510947004:1.text: You've already seen through the secret I tried to keep. I don't intend to hide it any longer, nor to make excuses.
say:5:1510947004:1.source_cn: 你已洞悉我所隐藏的秘密。我不想隐瞒，也不愿敷衍。

say:11:1510947013:1.text: It brings me great joy to see you here, Merlin.
say:11:1510947013:1.source_cn: 真高兴能在这里见到你，梅林。
say:11:1510947013:1.male: It brings me great joy to see you here, Merlin.
say:11:1510947013:1.female: It brings me great joy to see you here, Merlin.

say:12:1510947014:1.text: Standing here now... I glimpse the distant future. It tells me I entrusted things to the right person. That fills me with peace.
say:12:1510947014:1.source_cn: 你站在这里，让我预见了万年后的未来：我将事情托付给了正...

say:12:1510947014:1.female: Standing here now... I glimpse the distant future. It tells me I entrusted things to the right person. That fills me with peace.

choice_prompt:13:1510947014.text: Standing here now... I glimpse the distant future. It tells me I entrusted things to the right person. That fills me with peace.
choice_prompt:13:1510947014.source_cn: 你站在这里，让我预见了万年后的未来：我将事情托付给了正确的人。这令我非常喜悦。
choice_prompt:13:1510947014.male: Standing here now... I glimpse the distant future. It tells me I entrusted things to the right person. That fills me with peace.
choice_prompt:13:1510947014.female: Standing here now... I glimpse the distant future. It tells me I entrusted things to the right person. That fills me with peace.

say:14:1510947015:1.text: Don't worry. When the time is right, you'll remember everything.
say:14:1510947015:1.source_cn: 何必自责？等恰当的时机来临，你会记起一切。
say:14:1510947015:1.male: Don't worry. When the time is right, you'll remember everything.
say:14:1510947015:1.female: Don't worry. When the time is right, you'll remember everything.

say:15:1510947016:1.text: And even if you don't, fate will guide you to fulfill your destined role. Just as it brought you here, it will lead you to your answer.

say:16:1510947017:1.text: You only need to follow your heart... and <style="highlight">do what you believe is right</style>.

choice_prompt:17:1510947017.female: You only need to follow your heart... and <style="highlight">do what you believe is right</style>.

choice:29:1:2.text: Sounds like we can't just stroll in.
choice:29:1:2.male: Sounds like we can't just stroll in.
choice:29:1:2.female: Sounds like we can't just stroll in.

choice:25:0:1.source_cn: 艾雅也有做不到的事吗？

choice:25:1:2.text: Wouldn't your divine power be enough?
choice:25:1:2.source_cn: 你本身的神力还不够吗？
choice:25:1:2.male: Wouldn't your divine power be enough?
choice:25:1:2.female: Wouldn't your divine power be enough?

say:35:1510947024:1.text: I understand your concern for them.

say:35:1510947024:1.male: I understand your concern for them.

choice:17:0:1.male: Or you could just say it straight.
choice:17:0:1.female: Or you could just say it straight.

say:36:1510947019:1.text: In your own time, only you can decide that.

say:36:1510947019:1.male: In your own time, only you can decide that.
say:36:1510947019:1.female: In your own time, only you can decide that.

choice:17:1:2.text: What is the right thing to do?
choice:17:1:2.male: What is the right thing to do?
choice:17:1:2.female: What is the right thing to do?

choice:17:2:3.text: Dura... Vague and poetic, as always.
choice:17:2:3.source_cn: 果然，艾雅总是说一些很深奥的话
choice:17:2:3.male: Dura... Vague and poetic, as always.
choice:17:2:3.female: Dura... Vague and poetic, as always.

choice:13:0:1.source_cn: 但我不记得你托付的事了，抱歉

choice:4:0:1.text: You knew I'd come to find you.
choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 我来找你，你一点也不惊讶
choice:4:0:1.male: You knew I'd come to find you.
choice:4:0:1.female: You knew I'd come to find you.

say:37:1510947005:1.text: I've known her for a long time... The God of Harvest as well.
say:37:1510947005:1.source_cn: 我很早便与她相识……丰饶神也是如此。
say:37:1510947005:1.male: I've known her for a long time... The God of Harvest as well.
say:37:1510947005:1.female: I've known her for a long time... The God of Harvest as well.

say:38:1510947006:1.text: And not just them. There are many others—gods you may have never even heard of.
say:38:1510947006:1.source_cn: 除他们之外，还有很多神。很多你可能未曾听说的神。
say:38:1510947006:1.male: And not just them. There are many others—gods you may have never even heard of.
say:38:1510947006:1.female: And not just them. There are many others—gods you may have never even heard of.

choice:4:1:2.text: You seem very familiar with the goddess.
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 你好像对狩猎神很熟悉
choice:4:1:2.male: You seem very familiar with the goddess.
choice:4:1:2.female: You seem very familiar with the goddess.

say:39:1510947007:1.text: I had my reasons. I only wished to protect mortals from their grasp... to protect all of you.
say:39:1510947007:1.source_cn: 事出有因，我只想从他们手中保护凡人，保护你们。
say:39:1510947007:1.male: I had my reasons. I only wished to protect mortals from their grasp... to protect all of you.
say:39:1510947007:1.female: I had my reasons. I only wished to protect mortals from their grasp... to protect all of you.

say:40:1510947008:1.text: I've always kept my power hidden, to keep things fair. Except in that last battle.
say:40:1510947008:1.source_cn: 公平起见，我一直在隐藏自己的力量……除了刚刚那一战。
say:40:1510947008:1.male: I've always kept my power hidden, to keep things fair. Except in that last battle.
say:40:1510947008:1.female: I've always kept my power hidden, to keep things fair. Except in that last battle.

say:41:1510947009:1.text: Only divine power can stand against divine power. I couldn't just stand by and watch mortals become the Hunting Goddess' prey.
say:41:1510947009:1.source_cn: 唯有神力可对抗神力。我不能坐视凡人成为狩猎神的猎物。
say:41:1510947009:1.male: Only divine power can stand against divine power. I couldn't just stand by and watch mortals become the Hunting Goddess' prey.
say:41:1510947009:1.female: Only divine power can stand against divine power. I couldn't just stand by and watch mortals become the Hunting Goddess' prey.

choice:4:2:3.text: But you interfered with mortals too.
choice:4:2:3.male: But you interfered with mortals too.
choice:4:2:3.female: But you interfered with mortals too.
